description: Route property that lazy loads one standalone component: `loadComponent: () => import('./page')`.
Lazy loads a `Routes` array for a feature area (or an NgModule in legacy apps).
The bundler turns each dynamic `import()` into a separate chunk downloaded on demand.
`withPreloading(PreloadAllModules)` or a custom `PreloadingStrategy` fetches lazy chunks in the background.
`providers` on a route create an environment injector scoped to that route subtree.
